title: Map: SAM Sites in Cuba, August 1962, with U-2 photos of San Julian Airfield and La Coloma
description: Page titled "SAM Sites in Cuba, August 1962" with a map of Cuba marking surface-to-air missile site symbols across the western part of the island, including near Havana, La Coloma and San Julian. Below are two dark aerial reconnaissance photographs with circular SAM-site layouts, captioned "San Julian Airfield" and "La Coloma." Marked Secret NOFORN.
